verdict.rationale: Epic's own licensing page claims 'access to the source code' (unreal-docs-10, unreal-docs-18), but this is EULA/account-gated rather than an open-license grant — the probe confirms the GitHub source repo returns 404 without an authenticated, linked Epic account and all first-party domains block non-browser access, meaning the source is not freely readable under an open license as an AI-native user would need. Missing for 10: no OSI-approved or otherwise open license governing the source, no keyless/anonymous access to the code, no llms.txt or machine-readable confirmation of licensing terms.
